Description: ESP32-WROOM-32E-N4; 4 MB flash. WROOM-32 / WROOM-32E fit the same pads
AMS1117-3.3; 3.3 V fixed LDO, 1 A, tab = output
CH340C; Must be the C variant: internal oscillator, no crystal
MMBT3904; NPN, pin 1 B, 2 E, 3 C (marking 1AM)
AO3400A; N-MOSFET 30 V 5.7 A, logic level (works from 3.3 V gate)
PTC 1.1A 1812; Resettable fuse, 1.1 A hold, >= 6 V
PTC 0.5A 1206; Resettable fuse, 0.5 A hold, >= 6 V
10uF 0805; X5R or X7R, 10 V or higher
